input: We have a hard system hang on our CHI-based SoC during stress testing. All 8 cores are stuck — CoreSight CTI shows all PEs in debug halt state but none hit a breakpoint. The CMN-700 debug register dump shows several HN-F nodes with outstanding snoops that never completed: hnf_pocq_reqs_recvd is incrementing but hnf_pocq_reqs_done is frozen. The watchdog fires after 10 seconds. We suspect a CHI protocol deadlock — possibly a snoop filter conflict where two RN-F nodes hold conflicting cache lines and neither can complete the Snoop sequence. How do we use CMN-700 DTC (Debug Trace Controller) to capture the CHI transaction sequence leading to the hang, and what are common deadlock patterns in CHI mesh interconnects?
